Regularly review and update electronic messaging security measures to address new vulnerabilities.
Monitor electronic messaging systems for unauthorized access and potential security incidents.

controls.name: confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.description: Requirements for confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organizationΓÇÖs needs for the protection of information shall be identified, regularly reviewed and documented.

deployment_points.name: Identify key information assets that require protection through confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements.
Draft and implement standard confidentiality agreements that outline the obligations of all parties involved.
Regularly review and update agreements to ensure they reflect current organizational needs and legal requirements.
Train employees on the importance of confidentiality agreements and the implications of breaches.
Maintain a centralized repository for all confidentiality agreements to ensure easy access and management.

controls_data.name: Information Security Requirements Analysis And Specification

controls.name: information security requirements analysis and specification
controls.description: The information security related requirements shall be included in the requirements for new information systems or enhancements to existing information systems.

deployment_points.name: Establish a framework for identifying and documenting information security requirements during the system development lifecycle.
Involve stakeholders from IT, security, and business units in the requirements gathering process to ensure comprehensive coverage.
Review and validate security requirements against industry standards and best practices before finalizing them.
Ensure that security requirements are integrated into project plans and timelines for new systems or enhancements.
Conduct regular reviews of existing systems to identify and address any gaps in security requirements.

controls.name: securing application services on public networks
controls.description: Information involved in application services passing over public networks shall be protected from fraudulent activity, contract dispute and unauthorized disclosure and modification.

deployment_points.name: Implement strong encryption protocols for all application services that transmit data over public networks.
Conduct regular security assessments of application services to identify vulnerabilities and remediate them promptly.
Establish access controls to restrict who can access application services and the data they handle.
Monitor application services for unusual activity that may indicate fraudulent behavior or security breaches.
Provide training to developers on secure coding practices to minimize vulnerabilities in application services.

controls.name: protecting application services transactions
controls.description: Information involved in application service transactions shall be protected to prevent incomplete transmission, mis-routing, unauthorized message alteration, unauthorized disclosure, unauthorized message duplication or replay.

deployment_points.name: Implement transaction logging to track all application service transactions for auditing and monitoring purposes.
Use message integrity checks to ensure that messages are not altered during transmission.
Establish timeout mechanisms to prevent replay attacks on transaction messages.
Train staff on the importance of secure transaction processing and the risks associated with incomplete or altered transactions.
Regularly review and update transaction protection measures to address emerging threats and vulnerabilities.

controls.name: secure development policy
controls.description: Rules for the development of software and systems shall be established and applied to developments within the organization.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal secure development policy document that outlines security requirements and best practices for software development.
Train all development staff on the secure development policy to ensure understanding and compliance.
Integrate security checkpoints into the software development lifecycle to enforce adherence to the policy.
Regularly review and update the secure development policy to reflect changes in technology and security threats.
Implement a monitoring system to track compliance with the secure development policy across all development projects.

controls.name: system change control procedures
controls.description: Changes to systems within the development lifecycle shall be controlled by the use of formal change control procedures.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal change control procedure that outlines the steps for requesting, reviewing, and approving changes to systems.
Assign a change control board (CCB) responsible for evaluating and approving all proposed changes.
Document all changes, including the rationale, impact assessment, and approval status, in a centralized change log.
Communicate approved changes to all relevant stakeholders to ensure awareness and preparedness.
Conduct regular audits of the change control process to ensure compliance and identify areas for improvement.

controls.name: technical review of applications after operating platform changes
controls.description: When operating platforms are changed, business critical applications shall be reviewed and tested to ensure there is no adverse impact on organizational operations or security.

deployment_points.name: Establish a protocol for conducting technical reviews of applications whenever there are changes to the operating platform.
Identify business-critical applications that require review and prioritize them based on their importance to operations.
Develop a testing plan that includes functional, performance, and security testing to assess the impact of the platform change.
Document the results of the technical review and testing, including any issues identified and corrective actions taken.
Ensure that all stakeholders are informed of the review outcomes and any necessary adjustments to applications.

controls.name: restrictions on changes to software packages
controls.description: Modifications to software packages shall be discouraged, limited to necessary changes and all changes shall be strictly controlled.

deployment_points.name: Create a policy that outlines the restrictions on modifying software packages, emphasizing the need for minimal changes.
Implement a formal request process for any necessary modifications, requiring justification and approval.
Maintain a log of all changes made to software packages, including details of the modification and the approval process.
Conduct regular reviews of software packages to ensure compliance with the modification policy and identify unauthorized changes.
Provide training to development teams on the importance of adhering to the restrictions on software package changes.

controls.name: secure system engineering principles
controls.description: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system implementation efforts.

deployment_points.name: Define and document secure system engineering principles that align with industry best practices and organizational goals.
Ensure that all system development projects incorporate these principles from the initial design phase through implementation.
Provide training for engineering teams on secure system principles to enhance their understanding and application.
Regularly review and update the documented principles to reflect new security threats and technological advancements.
Establish a compliance verification process to ensure that all projects adhere to the secure system engineering principles.

controls.name: secure development environment
controls.description: Organizations shall establish and appropriately protect secure development environments for system development and integration efforts that cover the entire system development lifecycle.

deployment_points.name: Designate secure development environments that are isolated from production systems and accessible only to authorized personnel.
Implement access controls and authentication mechanisms to protect the secure development environment from unauthorized access.
Regularly update and patch the development environment to mitigate vulnerabilities and ensure security.
Conduct security assessments of the development environment to identify and address potential risks.
Document the configuration and security measures of the development environment to ensure consistency and compliance.

controls.name: outsourced development
controls.description: The organization shall supervise and monitor the activity of outsourced system development.

deployment_points.name: Establish a framework for selecting and evaluating third-party vendors for outsourced development projects.
Define clear contractual obligations regarding security and compliance for all outsourced development activities.
Implement regular monitoring and reporting mechanisms to track the progress and security of outsourced projects.
Conduct periodic audits of outsourced development activities to ensure adherence to organizational standards and policies.
Maintain open communication with outsourced teams to address any security concerns or issues promptly.

controls.name: system security testing
controls.description: Testing of security functionality shall be carried out during development.

deployment_points.name: Integrate security testing into the software development lifecycle, ensuring it occurs at multiple stages of development.
Define specific security testing criteria and methodologies to be used during the development process.
Train development teams on security testing techniques and tools to enhance their capabilities.
Document the results of security tests, including vulnerabilities identified and remediation actions taken.
Conduct reviews of security testing processes to ensure effectiveness and compliance with security standards.

controls.name: system acceptance testing
controls.description: Acceptance testing programs and related criteria shall be established for new information systems, upgrades and new versions.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive acceptance testing program that outlines the criteria for evaluating new systems and upgrades.
Involve key stakeholders in defining acceptance criteria to ensure alignment with business needs and security requirements.
Conduct acceptance testing in a controlled environment to validate functionality, performance, and security before deployment.
Document the outcomes of acceptance testing, including any issues found and resolutions implemented.
Establish a sign-off process for stakeholders to formally accept the system before it goes live.

controls.name: protection of test data
controls.description: Test data shall be selected carefully, protected and controlled.

deployment_points.name: Define a policy for selecting and using test data that ensures compliance with data protection regulations.
Implement data masking techniques to protect sensitive information in test data sets.
Control access to test data by restricting it to authorized personnel only and logging access attempts.
Regularly review and audit the use of test data to ensure compliance with protection policies.
Provide training to development teams on the importance of protecting test data and the methods used to secure it.

controls_data.name: Information Security Policy For Supplier Relationships

controls.name: information security policy for supplier relationships
controls.description: Information security requirements for mitigating the risks associated with supplierΓÇÖs access to the organizationΓÇÖs assets shall be agreed with the supplier and documented.

deployment_points.name: Identify and document the specific information security requirements that apply to supplier relationships based on the organization's risk assessment.
Engage with suppliers to discuss and negotiate the agreed-upon security requirements, ensuring mutual understanding and acceptance.
Create a formal agreement or contract that includes the documented information security requirements, specifying roles and responsibilities.
Establish a process for regular review and updates of the security requirements to adapt to changing risks or business needs.
Ensure that all relevant stakeholders are trained on the information security policy for supplier relationships and understand their responsibilities.

controls.name: addressing security within supplier agreements
controls.description: All relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier that may access, process, store, communicate, or provide IT infrastructure components for, the organizationΓÇÖs information.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a thorough assessment of each supplier's access to the organization's information and identify relevant security requirements.
Draft specific information security clauses to be included in supplier agreements, covering data handling, processing, and storage requirements.
Review and negotiate the security clauses with suppliers to ensure they are feasible and enforceable.
Implement a tracking system to monitor compliance with the agreed-upon security requirements in supplier agreements.
Schedule regular audits and reviews of supplier agreements to ensure ongoing compliance and address any emerging security concerns.

controls.name: information and communication technology supply chain
controls.description: Agreements with suppliers shall include requirements to address the information security risks associated with information and communications technology services and product supply chain.

deployment_points.name: Identify and document the specific information security risks associated with the ICT supply chain relevant to the organization.
Develop security requirements that address these risks and incorporate them into supplier agreements.
Ensure that suppliers are aware of and agree to the security requirements related to their products and services.
Establish a monitoring process to evaluate supplier compliance with the security requirements throughout the supply chain.
Conduct periodic risk assessments to identify new threats and update supplier agreements accordingly.

controls.name: monitoring and review of supplier services
controls.description: Organizations shall regularly monitor, review and audit supplier service delivery.

deployment_points.name: Develop a monitoring framework that outlines the key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics for evaluating supplier service delivery.
Schedule regular reviews and audits of supplier performance against the established KPIs to ensure compliance with service agreements.
Document findings from the reviews and audits, highlighting any areas of concern or non-compliance.
Communicate the results of the monitoring activities to relevant stakeholders and suppliers, ensuring transparency and accountability.
Implement corrective actions for any identified issues and track their resolution to improve supplier performance.

controls.name: managing changes to supplier services
controls.description: Changes to the provision of services by suppliers, including maintaining and improving existing information security policies, procedures and controls, shall be managed, taking account of the criticality of business information, systems and processes involved and re-assessment of risks.

deployment_points.name: Establish a change management process that includes assessing the impact of changes in supplier services on information security.
Require suppliers to submit change requests that detail the nature of the changes and their potential impact on security.
Conduct risk assessments for each proposed change to determine necessary adjustments to security policies and controls.
Communicate approved changes to all relevant stakeholders and ensure they are documented in the supplier agreement.
Monitor the implementation of changes to ensure they are executed as planned and evaluate their effectiveness post-implementation.

controls.name: responsibilities and procedures
controls.description: Management responsibilities and procedures shall be established to ensure a quick, effective and orderly response to information security incidents.

deployment_points.name: Define and document the roles and responsibilities of management and staff in responding to information security incidents.
Develop and implement incident response procedures that outline the steps to be taken in the event of an incident.
Train all relevant personnel on their responsibilities and the incident response procedures to ensure preparedness.
Establish a communication plan for reporting incidents to management and relevant stakeholders promptly.
Regularly review and update the incident response procedures to incorporate lessons learned from past incidents.

controls.name: reporting information security events
controls.description: Information security events shall be reported through appropriate management channels as quickly as possible.

deployment_points.name: Create a clear reporting structure that outlines the channels for reporting information security events within the organization.
Develop guidelines for employees on what constitutes an information security event and how to report it.
Implement a reporting tool or system that allows for quick and easy submission of security events by employees.
Train employees on the importance of timely reporting and the procedures to follow when an event occurs.
Monitor and analyze reported events to identify trends and areas for improvement in security practices.

controls.name: reporting information security weaknesses
controls.description: Employees and contractors using the organizationΓÇÖs information systems and services shall be required to note and report any observed or suspected information security weaknesses in systems or services.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal process for employees and contractors to report observed or suspected information security weaknesses.
Create awareness campaigns to educate staff on the importance of reporting weaknesses and how to identify them.
Develop a user-friendly reporting mechanism that allows for anonymous submissions if desired.
Ensure that all reports of weaknesses are documented and tracked for follow-up and resolution.
Regularly review reported weaknesses to identify patterns and implement necessary improvements to security measures.

controls.name: assessment of and decision on information security events
controls.description: Information security events shall be assessed and it shall be decided if they are to be classified as information security incidents.

deployment_points.name: Develop criteria for assessing information security events to determine their severity and potential impact.
Establish a dedicated team responsible for evaluating reported events and making classification decisions.
Implement a standardized assessment process that includes documentation of findings and decisions made.
Train the assessment team on the criteria and processes to ensure consistent evaluations.
Regularly review and update the assessment criteria based on emerging threats and organizational changes.

controls.name: response to information security incidents
controls.description: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.

deployment_points.name: Ensure that documented incident response procedures are readily accessible to all relevant personnel.
Conduct regular training and simulation exercises to prepare staff for responding to incidents according to the procedures.
Establish a communication protocol for informing stakeholders about incidents and response actions taken.
Monitor the effectiveness of the incident response actions taken and document lessons learned for future improvements.
Review and update incident response procedures regularly to reflect changes in the threat landscape and organizational structure.

controls.name: learning from information security incidents
controls.description: Knowledge gained from analysing and resolving information security incidents shall be used to reduce the likelihood or impact of future incidents.

deployment_points.name: Establish a dedicated incident response team responsible for analyzing security incidents and documenting findings.
Create a standardized incident report template to capture details of each incident, including root cause analysis and resolution steps.
Conduct regular training sessions for staff on lessons learned from past incidents to enhance awareness and preparedness.
Implement a feedback loop where insights from incident analysis are used to update security policies and procedures.
Schedule periodic reviews of incident reports to identify trends and areas for improvement in security measures.

controls.name: collection of evidence
controls.description: The organization shall define and apply procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of information, which can serve as evidence.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive evidence collection policy that outlines procedures for identifying and preserving potential evidence.
Train staff on the importance of evidence preservation and the specific steps to take when an incident occurs.
Ensure that all evidence collection tools and methods comply with legal and regulatory standards to maintain admissibility.
Create a chain of custody documentation process to track the handling of evidence from collection to storage.
Regularly review and update evidence collection procedures to adapt to new technologies and legal requirements.

controls.name: planning information security continuity
controls.description: The organization shall determine its requirements for information security and the continuity of information security management in adverse situations, e.g. during a crisis or disaster.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities that could impact information security continuity.
Define clear objectives for information security continuity based on the results of the risk assessment.
Develop a business continuity plan that includes specific strategies for maintaining information security during adverse situations.
Assign roles and responsibilities for continuity planning to ensure accountability and effective execution.
Test and update the continuity plan regularly to ensure its effectiveness and relevance to current organizational needs.

controls.name: implementing information security continuity
controls.description: The organization shall establish, document, implement and maintain processes, procedures and controls to ensure the required level of continuity for information security during an adverse situation.

deployment_points.name: Document all processes and procedures related to information security continuity in a centralized repository.
Implement technical controls such as backups, failover systems, and access controls to support continuity efforts.
Train employees on the established procedures to ensure they understand their roles during an adverse situation.
Regularly review and update the documented processes to reflect changes in technology and organizational structure.
Conduct drills and simulations to test the effectiveness of the continuity procedures and make necessary adjustments.

controls.name: verify, review and evaluate information security continuity
controls.description: The organization shall verify the established and implemented information security continuity controls at regular intervals in order to ensure that they are valid and effective during adverse situations.

deployment_points.name: Schedule regular audits of the information security continuity controls to assess their effectiveness and compliance.
Develop a checklist of criteria to evaluate the performance of continuity measures during adverse situations.
Gather feedback from staff involved in continuity efforts to identify areas for improvement.
Document the findings of each review and create action plans to address any identified weaknesses.
Ensure that the evaluation process is integrated into the overall information security management framework.

controls.name: availability of information processing facilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.

deployment_points.name: Assess the availability requirements for critical information processing facilities based on business needs and risk assessments.
Implement redundant systems and components, such as backup power supplies and network connections, to ensure continuous operation.
Regularly test the redundancy measures to confirm they function correctly during outages or failures.
Document the architecture of the information processing facilities, including redundancy configurations, for reference and compliance.
Establish monitoring systems to detect failures in real-time and trigger alerts for immediate response.

controls_data.name: Identification Of Applicable Legislation And Contractual Requirements

controls.name: identification of applicable legislation and contractual requirements
controls.description: All relevant legislative statutory, regulatory, contractual requirements and the organizationΓÇÖs approach to meet these requirements shall be explicitly identified, documented and kept up to date for each information system and the organization.

deployment_points.name: Create a comprehensive inventory of all applicable legislation, regulations, and contractual obligations relevant to information systems.
Assign responsibility for monitoring changes in legislation and contractual requirements to a designated compliance officer.
Develop a documentation process to ensure that all requirements are recorded and updated regularly.
Conduct training sessions for relevant staff to ensure awareness and understanding of compliance obligations.
Implement a review process to assess compliance with identified requirements and address any gaps.

controls.name: intellectual property rights
controls.description: Appropriate procedures shall be implemented to ensure compliance with legislative, regulatory and contractual requirements related to intellectual property rights and use of proprietary software products.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document policies regarding the use of intellectual property and proprietary software within the organization.
Train employees on intellectual property rights and the importance of compliance with relevant laws and regulations.
Implement a monitoring system to track the use of proprietary software and ensure licensing compliance.
Establish a reporting mechanism for employees to report potential violations of intellectual property rights.
Regularly review and update intellectual property policies to reflect changes in legislation and business practices.

controls.name: protection of records
controls.description: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access and unauthorized release, in accordance with legislatory, regulatory, contractual and business requirements.

deployment_points.name: Identify and classify records based on sensitivity and regulatory requirements to determine appropriate protection measures.
Implement access controls to restrict unauthorized access to sensitive records and ensure only authorized personnel can access them.
Establish data backup procedures to protect records from loss or destruction, including regular testing of backup systems.
Develop a retention policy that outlines how long records should be kept and the process for secure disposal when no longer needed.
Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with protection measures and identify any vulnerabilities.

controls.name: privacy and protection of personally identifiable information
controls.description: Privacy and protection of personally identifiable information shall be ensured as required in relevant legislation and regulation where applicable.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a privacy impact assessment to identify risks associated with the handling of personally identifiable information (PII).
Develop and implement policies and procedures for the collection, storage, and processing of PII in compliance with relevant laws.
Train employees on data privacy principles and the importance of protecting PII from unauthorized access and breaches.
Implement technical controls such as encryption and access restrictions to safeguard PII.
Regularly review and update privacy policies to ensure ongoing compliance with changing legislation and best practices.

controls.name: regulation of cryptographic controls
controls.description: Cryptographic controls shall be used in compliance with all relevant agreements, legislation and regulations.

deployment_points.name: Identify all relevant agreements, legislation, and regulations that govern the use of cryptographic controls within your organization.
Develop a comprehensive policy that outlines the specific cryptographic controls to be implemented, ensuring alignment with identified legal requirements.
Train staff on the importance of compliance with cryptographic controls and the specific policies in place to ensure adherence.
Implement technical measures to enforce cryptographic controls, such as encryption protocols and key management systems, across all relevant systems.
Regularly review and update the cryptographic controls and associated policies to reflect any changes in legislation or organizational requirements.

controls.name: independent review of information security
controls.description: The organizationΓÇÖs approach to managing information security and its implementation shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.

deployment_points.name: Establish a schedule for independent reviews of the information security management approach, ensuring they occur at least annually or after significant changes.
Select qualified external auditors or independent reviewers with expertise in information security to conduct the reviews.
Prepare documentation and evidence of current information security practices and policies to facilitate the review process.
Address any findings or recommendations from the independent review promptly, implementing necessary changes to improve security posture.
Document the outcomes of the independent reviews and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders to ensure transparency and accountability.

controls.name: compliance with security policies and standards
controls.description: Managers shall regularly review the compliance of information processing and procedures within their area of responsibility with the appropriate security policies, standards and any other security requirements.

deployment_points.name: Assign specific managers the responsibility for reviewing compliance with security policies and standards within their respective areas.
Develop a compliance review checklist that aligns with the organizationΓÇÖs security policies and standards to guide the review process.
Schedule regular compliance reviews, ensuring they occur at least quarterly, and document the findings for accountability.
Provide training and resources to managers to help them understand the security policies and how to assess compliance effectively.
Implement corrective actions for any identified non-compliance issues and track progress to ensure resolution.

controls.name: technical compliance review
controls.description: Information systems shall be regularly reviewed for compliance with the organizationΓÇÖs information security policies and standards.

deployment_points.name: Develop a schedule for conducting technical compliance reviews of information systems, ensuring they are performed at least bi-annually.
Create a detailed checklist based on the organizationΓÇÖs information security policies and standards to guide the technical review process.
Utilize automated tools where possible to assess compliance and identify vulnerabilities in information systems.
Document the results of the technical compliance reviews, including any non-compliance issues and recommended remediation actions.
Ensure that findings from the reviews are communicated to relevant IT personnel and management for timely resolution and continuous improvement.

controls.name: control of outsourced processes
controls.description: Where an organization chooses to outsource any process that affects product conformity with requirements, the organization shall ensure control over such processes. Control of such outsourced processes shall be identified within the quality management system.

deployment_points.name: Identify all processes that are outsourced and assess their impact on product conformity.
Establish criteria for selecting and evaluating outsourcing partners to ensure they meet quality standards.
Develop a documented procedure to monitor and control outsourced processes, including regular audits and performance reviews.
Ensure that all outsourced processes are integrated into the quality management system and that responsibilities are clearly defined.
Maintain records of all outsourced processes and their performance to ensure compliance and facilitate continuous improvement.

controls.name: quality manual
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain a quality manual that includes the scope of the quality management system, including details of and justification for any exclusions, the documented procedures established for the quality management system, or reference to them, and a description of the interaction between the processes of the quality management system.

deployment_points.name: Draft a quality manual that outlines the scope and objectives of the quality management system.
Include justifications for any exclusions and ensure they are documented clearly.
Reference all documented procedures related to the quality management system within the manual.
Describe the interactions between different processes in the quality management system to ensure clarity.
Review and update the quality manual regularly to reflect changes in processes or organizational structure.

controls.name: control of documents
controls.description: Documents required by the quality management system shall be controlled. A documented procedure shall be established to define the controls needed to approve documents for adequacy prior to issue, to review and update as necessary and re-approve documents, to ensure that changes and the current revision status of documents are identified, to ensure that relevant versions of applicable documents are available at points of use, to ensure that documents remain legible and identifiable, to ensure that documents of external origin are identified and their distribution controlled, and to prevent the unintended use of obsolete documents.

deployment_points.name: Establish a documented procedure for the approval, review, and update of all quality management system documents.
Implement a version control system to track changes and ensure the current revision status is easily identifiable.
Ensure that all relevant documents are accessible at points of use and that obsolete documents are removed from circulation.
Train staff on the importance of document control and the procedures in place to maintain document integrity.
Regularly audit document control processes to ensure compliance and identify areas for improvement.

controls.name: control of records
controls.description: Records shall be established and maintained to provide evidence of conformity to requirements and of the effective operation of the quality management system. Records shall remain legible, readily identifiable and retrievable. A documented procedure shall be established to define the controls needed for the identification, storage, protection, retrieval, retention time and disposition of records.

deployment_points.name: Develop a documented procedure for the identification, storage, and protection of quality management system records.
Ensure that all records are legible, identifiable, and retrievable by implementing a systematic filing system.
Define retention times for different types of records based on regulatory and organizational requirements.
Train personnel on the importance of record keeping and the procedures for maintaining records.
Conduct regular reviews of records management practices to ensure compliance and effectiveness.

controls.name: management commitment
controls.description: Top management shall demonstrate leadership and commitment with respect to the quality management system by ensuring that the quality policy and objectives are established and are compatible with the strategic direction and the context of the organization, and that the quality management system is integrated into the organization's business processes.

deployment_points.name: Establish a quality policy that aligns with the organization's strategic direction and objectives.
Communicate the importance of the quality management system to all employees and stakeholders.
Integrate quality objectives into the organization's business processes to ensure alignment and commitment.
Regularly review and update the quality policy and objectives to reflect changes in the organization or market.
Lead by example, demonstrating commitment to quality through active participation in quality initiatives.

controls.name: customer focus
controls.description: Top management shall demonstrate leadership and commitment with respect to customer focus by ensuring that customer requirements are determined and are met with the aim of enhancing customer satisfaction.

deployment_points.name: Establish processes to gather and analyze customer requirements and feedback systematically.
Ensure that customer satisfaction metrics are defined and monitored regularly.
Communicate customer requirements and expectations to all relevant departments within the organization.
Implement corrective actions based on customer feedback to enhance satisfaction and loyalty.
Regularly review customer focus initiatives to ensure they are effective and aligned with organizational goals.

controls.name: quality policy
controls.description: Top management shall establish, implement and maintain a quality policy that: a) is appropriate to the purpose and context of the organization; b) provides a framework for setting quality objectives; c) includes a commitment to satisfy applicable requirements; and d) includes a commitment to continual improvement of the quality management system.

deployment_points.name: Draft a quality policy that reflects the organization's purpose, context, and strategic direction.
Ensure the quality policy is communicated to all employees and stakeholders to foster understanding and commitment.
Establish measurable quality objectives that align with the quality policy and organizational goals.
Regularly review and update the quality policy to ensure its relevance and effectiveness.
Promote a culture of continual improvement by encouraging feedback and suggestions from employees.

controls.name: planning
controls.description: Top management shall ensure that: a) the planning of the quality management system is aligned with the strategic direction of the organization; b) quality objectives are established at relevant functions and levels; and c) the planning of the quality management system is carried out in such a way that it is integrated into the organization's business processes.

deployment_points.name: Align the planning of the quality management system with the organization's strategic goals and objectives.
Involve relevant stakeholders in the establishment of quality objectives at all levels of the organization.
Develop a comprehensive plan that integrates quality management into all business processes.
Monitor the implementation of the quality management plan to ensure alignment and effectiveness.
Review and adjust the quality management plan regularly to respond to changes in the organization or market.

controls.name: management representative
controls.description: Top management shall appoint a member of management who, irrespective of other responsibilities, shall have responsibility and authority that includes ensuring that processes needed for the quality management system are established, implemented and maintained.

deployment_points.name: Appoint a qualified management representative with clear authority and responsibility for the quality management system.
Define the roles and responsibilities of the management representative in relation to quality processes.
Ensure the management representative has the necessary resources and support to fulfill their duties effectively.
Facilitate regular communication between the management representative and top management regarding quality issues.
Monitor the effectiveness of the management representative's role and make adjustments as necessary.

controls.name: management reviews
controls.description: The organization shall conduct management reviews at planned intervals to ensure the quality management system is still adequate, effective and aligned with the strategic direction of the organization.

deployment_points.name: Schedule regular management review meetings to assess the quality management system's performance.
Prepare an agenda that includes key performance indicators, audit results, and customer feedback for discussion.
Document the outcomes of management reviews, including decisions made and actions assigned.
Ensure that follow-up actions from previous reviews are addressed and tracked for completion.
Use the findings from management reviews to drive continuous improvement in the quality management system.

controls.name: provision of resources
controls.description: The organization shall determine and provide the resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance and continual improvement of the quality management system.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a resource assessment to identify the necessary resources for the quality management system.
Allocate budget and personnel to ensure the availability of identified resources.
Establish a process for monitoring resource utilization and effectiveness.
Implement training programs to enhance the skills of personnel involved in resource management.
Regularly review and update resource requirements based on system performance and feedback.

controls.name: human resources
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that the personnel performing work under its control are competent on the basis of appropriate education, training, or experience.

deployment_points.name: Develop a competency framework that outlines the required skills and qualifications for each role.
Implement a recruitment process that assesses candidates against the competency framework.
Provide ongoing training and development opportunities to enhance employee skills.
Conduct regular performance evaluations to assess employee competence and identify training needs.
Maintain records of employee qualifications, training, and experience for compliance and improvement purposes.

controls.name: infrastructure
controls.description: The organization shall determine, provide and maintain the infrastructure needed to achieve conformity to product requirements.

deployment_points.name: Identify the infrastructure requirements necessary for achieving product conformity, including facilities, equipment, and technology.
Develop a maintenance schedule for all infrastructure components to ensure they are in good working condition.
Allocate resources for the acquisition and upgrade of infrastructure as needed.
Implement safety and compliance checks to ensure infrastructure meets regulatory standards.
Regularly review infrastructure performance and make adjustments based on operational needs and product requirements.

controls.name: work environment
controls.description: The organization shall determine and manage the work environment needed to achieve conformity to product requirements.

deployment_points.name: Assess the current work environment to identify factors that affect product quality and employee performance.
Implement changes to the work environment that promote safety, efficiency, and employee well-being.
Establish protocols for maintaining a clean and organized workspace to minimize distractions and hazards.
Provide necessary tools and equipment to support employees in their tasks effectively.
Regularly solicit employee feedback on the work environment and make improvements based on their suggestions.

controls.name: planning of product realization
controls.description: The organization shall plan and develop the processes needed for product realization.

deployment_points.name: Define the stages of the product realization process, from concept to delivery.
Identify key stakeholders and their roles in the product realization process.
Develop a timeline and milestones for each stage of the product realization.
Allocate resources and assign responsibilities for each phase of the planning process.
Establish a review mechanism to assess the effectiveness of the planning process and make necessary adjustments.

controls.name: gathering customer requirements
controls.description: Establish a process for gathering customer requirements through surveys, interviews, and market research.

deployment_points.name: Design and implement surveys and interview templates to collect customer feedback effectively.
Schedule regular market research activities to stay updated on customer needs and industry trends.
Train staff on effective communication techniques to engage customers during interviews.
Compile and analyze gathered data to identify common themes and requirements.
Document customer requirements in a centralized system for easy access and reference.

controls.name: documenting customer requirements
controls.description: Document and analyze customer requirements to ensure clarity and feasibility.

deployment_points.name: Create a standardized template for documenting customer requirements to ensure consistency.
Analyze documented requirements for clarity, feasibility, and alignment with business objectives.
Involve relevant stakeholders in the review process to validate the documented requirements.
Store documented requirements in a secure, accessible location for future reference.
Regularly update documentation to reflect any changes in customer requirements or business context.

controls.name: communicating customer requirements
controls.description: Communicate customer requirements to all relevant departments involved in product development.

deployment_points.name: Develop a communication plan that outlines how customer requirements will be shared across departments.
Schedule regular meetings to discuss customer requirements and their implications for product development.
Utilize collaboration tools to ensure all departments have access to the latest customer requirements.
Assign a liaison from each department to facilitate communication and address any questions.
Monitor the effectiveness of communication efforts and adjust strategies as needed.

controls.name: reviewing customer requirements
controls.description: Implement a review process to regularly assess and update customer requirements based on feedback.

deployment_points.name: Establish a schedule for regular reviews of customer requirements to ensure they remain relevant.
Gather feedback from customers and stakeholders to inform the review process.
Document any changes to customer requirements and communicate them to all relevant parties.
Involve cross-functional teams in the review process to gain diverse perspectives.
Create a feedback loop to continuously improve the review process based on lessons learned.

controls.name: integrating customer requirements
controls.description: Ensure that customer requirements are integrated into the product realization planning and execution.

deployment_points.name: Develop a framework for integrating customer requirements into the product development lifecycle.
Ensure that all product plans and specifications reference customer requirements explicitly.
Train teams on the importance of customer requirements in their respective roles.
Monitor the implementation of customer requirements throughout the product realization process.
Conduct post-launch reviews to assess how well customer requirements were met and identify areas for improvement.

controls.name: defining design and development stages
controls.description: Define the design and development stages, including concept, design, testing, and validation.

deployment_points.name: Identify and outline the key stages of the design and development process, including concept, design, testing, and validation phases.
Create a detailed document that describes each stage, including objectives, deliverables, and timelines.
Assign team members to each stage, ensuring they understand their roles and responsibilities within the process.
Establish a communication plan to facilitate collaboration and updates among team members throughout the stages.
Review and update the defined stages regularly to incorporate lessons learned and improve future design and development efforts.

controls.name: assigning roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Assign roles and responsibilities for each stage of the design and development process.

deployment_points.name: Develop a roles and responsibilities matrix that clearly outlines who is responsible for each stage of the design and development process.
Communicate the assigned roles to all team members to ensure clarity and accountability.
Provide training or resources to team members to help them understand their specific responsibilities and expectations.
Schedule regular check-ins to discuss progress and address any role-related challenges that may arise.
Update the roles and responsibilities matrix as needed to reflect changes in team structure or project scope.

controls.name: review and approval process for design outputs
controls.description: Implement a review and approval process for design outputs to ensure they meet requirements.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal review process that includes defined criteria for evaluating design outputs at each stage.
Identify stakeholders who will participate in the review and approval process, ensuring they have the necessary expertise.
Create a checklist or template to standardize the review process and ensure all requirements are assessed.
Schedule review meetings to discuss feedback and make necessary revisions to design outputs before final approval.
Document all review outcomes and approvals to maintain a clear record of compliance with requirements.

controls.name: conducting regular design reviews
controls.description: Conduct regular design reviews to identify and mitigate risks early in the development process.

deployment_points.name: Schedule regular design review meetings at key milestones throughout the development process to assess progress and identify risks.
Prepare an agenda for each meeting that includes specific topics for discussion, such as design challenges and risk assessments.
Involve cross-functional team members in the reviews to gain diverse perspectives on potential risks and solutions.
Document the outcomes of each design review, including identified risks and agreed-upon action items.
Follow up on action items from previous reviews to ensure that risks are being addressed in a timely manner.

controls.name: documenting design and development activities
controls.description: Document all design and development activities for traceability and compliance.

deployment_points.name: Create a centralized repository for all design and development documentation to ensure easy access and traceability.
Establish guidelines for what types of activities and decisions need to be documented, including design changes and approvals.
Assign responsibility for documentation to specific team members to ensure accountability and completeness.
Regularly review and update documentation to reflect the most current information and decisions made during the design process.
Ensure that all documentation is compliant with relevant standards and regulations for traceability and audit purposes.

controls.name: developing specifications for purchased products
controls.description: Develop clear specifications for all purchased products to ensure they meet quality standards.

deployment_points.name: Identify the key quality standards and requirements that all purchased products must meet based on organizational needs.
Create detailed specifications for each product category, including performance criteria, materials, and compliance requirements.
Involve relevant stakeholders in the specification development process to ensure all perspectives are considered.
Review and validate the specifications with stakeholders to ensure they are clear, comprehensive, and achievable.
Document the specifications in a centralized location for easy reference during the purchasing process.

controls.name: supplier evaluation and selection process
controls.description: Establish a supplier evaluation and selection process based on quality, reliability, and performance.

deployment_points.name: Develop criteria for evaluating suppliers, focusing on quality, reliability, performance, and compliance with specifications.
Create a standardized evaluation form to assess potential suppliers against the established criteria.
Conduct thorough research and gather data on potential suppliers, including references and past performance records.
Schedule meetings or site visits with shortlisted suppliers to assess their capabilities and quality management practices.
Document the evaluation process and decisions made to ensure transparency and accountability in supplier selection.

controls.name: implementing purchasing agreements
controls.description: Implement a purchasing agreement that includes quality requirements and compliance expectations.

deployment_points.name: Draft a purchasing agreement template that includes all necessary quality requirements and compliance expectations for suppliers.
Review the agreement with legal and procurement teams to ensure it meets organizational standards and regulations.
Present the agreement to selected suppliers for negotiation and finalization, ensuring mutual understanding of terms.
Establish a process for monitoring compliance with the purchasing agreement throughout the supplier relationship.
Keep a record of all signed agreements and any amendments for future reference and audits.

controls.name: conducting supplier audits
controls.description: Conduct regular audits of suppliers to ensure ongoing compliance with purchase requirements.

deployment_points.name: Develop an audit schedule that outlines the frequency and scope of supplier audits based on risk and importance.
Create an audit checklist that includes key compliance areas to assess during the audit process.
Assign qualified personnel to conduct the audits, ensuring they have the necessary expertise and independence.
Document the findings of each audit, including any non-conformities and areas for improvement.
Follow up on audit findings with suppliers to ensure corrective actions are implemented and compliance is maintained.

controls.name: maintaining records of supplier performance
controls.description: Maintain records of supplier performance and product conformity for future reference.

deployment_points.name: Establish a system for tracking and recording supplier performance metrics, including delivery times, quality issues, and compliance rates.
Create a standardized format for documenting supplier performance to ensure consistency and ease of analysis.
Schedule regular reviews of supplier performance records to identify trends and areas for improvement.
Share performance data with suppliers to foster transparency and encourage continuous improvement.
Maintain records in a secure and accessible location to support future evaluations and audits.

controls.name: developing a production plan
controls.description: Develop a production plan that outlines processes, resources, and timelines for production activities.
